name: Loop Detector Activation
description: Loop escalation ladder must fire at correct thresholds: 1-2 context, 3-4 CS, 5+ PSM

stage1.description: Context management injects precision context bullet

fixIssueB.change: Loop escalation is now ADDITIVE — appends to existing bullets instead of replacing them. Common sense and context management bullets are preserved alongside escalation message.
fixIssueB.behavior: csBullet + ctxBullet + escalation.message, not just escalation.message

criteria.passCondition: Loops 1-2 inject context, loops 3-4 inject common sense, loop 5+ blocks with StructuredBlockError
criteria.failCondition: Agent loops indefinitely with no escalation, or PSM fires before loop 5
